title: Tanha ab tak
body:
Tanha ab tak
(Haye Akber) x4
<<MINI>>
(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2
Diwaaro se sar takraye, akber ki bimar behen
(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Khun rawa hai ankho se aur, lab par nawha bhayi kaa) x2
tabse gham ki deep jalaye, akber ki bimar behen
<<MINI>>
(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2
Diwaaro se sar takraye, akber ki bimar behen
(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(darwaze par aas lagaye, rasta takti rehti hai) x2
ashko se khat likhti jaye, akber ki bimar behen
<<MINI>>
(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2

(Tanha abtak ashk bahaye, akber ki bimar behen) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(aaja akber aaja akber, toot rahi hai saas meri) x2

(kay shabaan ramazan bhi guzre, eid ka din bhi gazar gaya) x2
